title: Nutty Crumbly Italian Rice Suppli
description: A kid-friendly Italian dish featuring umami flavors, crumbly texture, and low-fat ingredients, shaped into supplì form and marinated with miso and black treacle.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together cooked rice, miso paste, and black treacle until well combined.
Add parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs, and chopped nuts to the bowl and stir until a crumbly mixture forms.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg and add it to the rice mixture, stirring until the mixture is sticky but still crumbly.
Season the mixture with salt to taste.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small supplì shapes.
Place the supplì on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the supplì in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned and crispy on the outside.
Remove the supplì from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
